items.mainDefect: The header panel loses right alignment in legacy flexbox implementations because they do not support main-axis auto margins.

secondary.defect: The align-items() mixin lacks -moz-box-align, so alignment does not apply in old Firefox using -moz-box.

items.mainDefect: The align-items() mixin emits the nonexistent -ms-align-items property, leaving a dead and misleading declaration.

secondary.defect: The align-items() mixin lacks -moz-box-align, so alignment does not apply in old Firefox using -moz-box.
